author: Alex Kahn
description: Tiny error helpers for @absolutejs Eden Treaty clients. Unwraps Eden's { status, value } failure shape into a real Error that KEEPS the HTTP status, so call sites stop dropping it. Zero dependencies.
name: @absolutejs/eden

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json
